init.title: Audiobookshelf Transcoder Proxy Controller Options
init.description:
Configure playback speed, audio routing, and target devices.

- **Default speed** applies to new sessions.
- **Target media players** are physical devices; each creates a dedicated virtual player.
- **Audio stream proxy mode**:
  - **Auto** routes through Home Assistant only when abstp is on localhost, except for Yandex Station. All other cases use a direct abstp stream URL.
  - **Always** routes through Home Assistant.
  - **Never** sends the abstp URL directly.
